title: Friedrich-M/UniMate
friendlyTitle: UniMate animates different kinds of character skeletons
summary: UniMate is an MIT-licensed research implementation of a unified model for animating characters with different skeletal structures. It supports text-to-motion, in-betweening, guided editing and motion expansion, with training and inference code available.
friendlySummary: This open project turns text into motion and can edit or extend movement for characters with different body structures.
whyItMatters: Animation and graphics researchers can test one motion system across varied rigs instead of maintaining a separate model for each skeleton type. Dataset licences still need to be checked independently before commercial use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Researchers and animation developers can study or test one motion model across many character rigs. Check the licence for each dataset before using it commercially.
